title: Amazon Prime Day 2025 Returns This July 8-11: See the Best Deals You Can Shop Now + Everything We Know
description: Amazon Prime Day 2025 is set for July 8 to July 11, extending to a four-day event. Shoppers can expect deals on entertainment tech including audio equipment, gaming accessories, and streaming devices. Early access and Prime Gaming bonuses enhance the shopping experience.
content_summary: Amazon Prime Day 2025 will be held from July 8 to July 11, marking a return to a longer four-day sales event. This extension offers Amazon Prime members a better opportunity to access various deals, especially in entertainment categories. Past Prime Days have offered discounts on audio equipment such as wireless Bluetooth speakers and headphones, gaming accessories, and consoles. Prime Gaming members can also benefit from free PC games and exclusive offers leading up to and during the event. Shoppers are advised to prepare by creating wish lists, utilizing price tracking tools, and taking advantage of early access deals for maximum savings. As the event approaches, Amazon is expected to release specific deals targeted toward entertainment products, enhancing the shopping experience further. Continued updates will be provided on Amazon's official channels.

title: Jon Stewart Calls Out Normalization Of Violence In The U.S., Says Our Sole Concern Is 'Whose Side The Perp Belongs To'
description: Jon Stewart highlights the disturbing trend of normalized violence in America, discussing political rhetoric, selective outrage, and recent violent incidents with a tone blending humor and hard-hitting critique.
content_summary: In his recent commentary, Jon Stewart addresses the alarming normalization of violence in the U.S., pointing out how political rhetoric and extremist actions once considered unacceptable are increasingly tolerated. He discusses Israel's strike on Iran in the context of escalating global conflicts and U.S. foreign policy impacts. Stewart critiques the selective outrage by some political factions, especially MAGA supporters, contrasting reactions to immigrant-related violence versus gun violence by domestic actors. He also focuses on the Minnesota lawmaker shootings, highlighting risks stemming from increased societal polarization and diminished accountability. Stewart's approach combines humor with serious analysis, aiming to raise awareness about the erosion of democratic norms and the growing dangers posed by unbridled violence in contemporary America.

title: Disney & Amazon Advertising Units Team Up: 'We're Breaking Down Traditional Barriers Between Content And Commerce'
description: Disney Advertising and Amazon Ads have partnered to integrate Disney's premium streaming inventory with Amazon's commerce data, enabling smarter audience targeting and improved advertising performance in streaming.
content_summary: Disney Advertising and Amazon Ads announced a strategic partnership on June 17, 2025, that links Disney's Real-Time Ad Exchange (DRAX) with Amazon DSP. This integration allows advertisers to access Disney+ and other premium streaming platforms' inventory through Amazon's ad platform, combining audience insights from both companies. The technical collaboration, leveraging AWS Clean Rooms technology, facilitates privacy-compliant data sharing for precise ad targeting. The partnership begins with rollouts in European markets and aims to offer advertisers streamlined access, higher reach, and reduced costs by merging commerce and content signals. This move breaks down traditional advertising silos, empowering streaming buyers with innovative targeting tools and expanding reach within the entertainment category.
